title: Audition decoded sequence tracks
changes: Add a wiki view of song IDs and decoded tracks, with a bounded instruction trace and note timeline.
Audition one track using a sine wave and a user-selected tick rate; follow waits, jumps, patterns, returns and note ties, and limit preview duration and work.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-sequence-03jtgkmw checked audio and sprite coexistence, sequence branches, ties, cycle limits, trace pagination, invalid rates and audio controls.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-sequence-eur-mli6tkjk compared all 105253 instruction fields and successors, 1610 tracks and 640 song-directory entries and checked selection and audio controls in Chrome.
limitations: The audition is an approximation of one track, not original song playback: instruments, tempo, pitch and note-extension commands, effects and simultaneous tracks are not reproduced. Actual physical audio output remains unverified.
EUR attempt bizuie80 failed because the sprite catalog overwrote the audio sequence variable. The variable was separated and a coexistence regression test was added.
